props.name: children
props.comment: Rendered inside the context, so a child can call `useCsvImport()`.

props.name: fields
props.comment: Overrides the schema's keys. Without either, the CSV headers are the fields.

props.name: mapping
props.comment: A starting field to header mapping. When non-empty it replaces the auto-match.

props.name: resource
props.comment: The resource to create into. Defaults to the ambient resource.

props.name: schema
props.comment: A Standard Schema (zod, valibot, ...). Its keys are the fields; its non-optional keys are required.

props.name: transform
props.comment: Reshapes a mapped row before the schema sees it.
